_meta.render: pdftoppm -jpeg -r 110 (all 6 pages; pdftoppm reports xref corruption - 'Couldn't find trailer dictionary', 'Kid object (page 3) is wrong type (null)')
_meta.notes: DAMAGED SCAN - needs a human. Page 2 carries the 'Summary Page' heading and its page box ('Page 2 of 6 / HATCH / 9/15/6'), but the 7-line summary TABLE was never captured: the scanner fed two skewed Schedule A sheets over that page, so the whole table area is covered by itemized-contribution rows. Every totals field is therefore null (illegible/not present in the scan), NOT zero. The PDF itself is corrupt (pdftoppm xref errors, one page object null). I walked all 6 pages: p1 cover, p2 the damaged Summary Page, p3 = form 'Page 4 of 6' Schedule A, p4 = form 'Page 5 of 6' Schedule A, p5 and p6 are BOTH form 'Page 6 of 6' Schedule B (duplicated); the form's own page 3 of 6 is absent. For a human's reference only (NOT transcribed into totals): the Schedule A pages print 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED 7175-' and the Schedule B page prints 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE 1906-'. Neither amendment box is checked; the cover's Type-of-Report block uses the generic (undated) box labels, not the 2006 dated ones.

itemized.itemized_pages_B: 5 (page 6 is a byte-level duplicate of page 5)

contributions.detail: NO STATED ANCHOR EXISTS - Summary Page line 1 Column A was destroyed by the scan damage (this filing is one of the corpus's 8 true illegibility cases). Against the SCHEDULE's own printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED of 7175 (printed identically on all three Schedule A pages), the 29 transcribed rows sum to 6975.00 - a 200.00 shortfall that sits entirely on the damaged page 2 (see page_subtotal_gates). The side is therefore a FLOOR, not a reconciled figure.

expenditures.detail: NO STATED ANCHOR EXISTS - Summary Page line 2 Column A was destroyed. Against the schedule's own printed SUBTOTAL/TOTAL of 1906, the 11 transcribed rows sum to exactly 1906.00, so the expenditure side is internally complete even though the Summary Page anchor is gone.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: THREE contribution page gates. p3: 15 rows sum 1445.00 = printed SUBTOTAL 1445 - PASSED. p4: 1 row sums 50.00 = printed SUBTOTAL 50 - PASSED. p2 (the damaged overprint): 13 readable rows sum 5480.00 against a printed SUBTOTAL of 5680 - GATE FIRED AND WOULD NOT CLOSE, a 200.00 gap, BOTH FIGURES NAMED HERE AND NO ROW ADJUSTED. The amount column of that page was re-rendered at 600 dpi with contrast normalisation and every one of the 13 figures re-read identically, so the gap is not a misread digit - the likeliest cause is one row of the sheet being concealed under the double-feed overlap. The filer's own arithmetic is self-consistent with 5680 (5680 + 1445 + 50 = 7175 = the printed TOTAL on all three pages). Expenditures p5: 11 rows sum 1906.00 = printed SUBTOTAL 1906 = printed TOTAL 1906 - PASSED, and that identity is also what settled the overwritten 8.00 in row 1.
itemized.escalation_note: the original PDF has a broken xref and poppler CANNOT render pages 1-2 at all; a Ghostscript-rewritten copy was made in /tmp and pages 1-2 rendered from it (pages 3-6 were rendered from the original). The page-2 amount column was then re-rendered at 600 dpi in two contrast-normalised band crops - all 13 figures re-read identically and the 200 gap persisted.
itemized.notes: DAMAGED FILING - A HUMAN SHOULD LOOK AT THIS ONE. (1) The source PDF's cross-reference table is broken; poppler refuses pages 1-2 and a Ghostscript rewrite was needed to see them. (2) PDF page 2 is the Summary Page with a Schedule A sheet fed OVER it: the summary's 7-line table is completely obliterated (which is why both stated totals are blank in the manifest), and what survives is a split image of the missing Schedule A sheet - Address/Occupation/Amount on the left, Date/Name on the right. Those 13 rows are transcribed at LOW confidence with the pairing rationale in each row note. (3) PDF PAGES 5 AND 6 ARE THE SAME PAGE - both are Schedule B 'Page 6 of 6', visually identical; only one is transcribed and the duplicate is noted rather than double-counted. (4) The document is a 6-page form: p1 cover, p2 Summary, p3-p5 Schedule A, p6 Schedule B; the Schedule A pages present in the PDF carry header boxes 'Page 4 of 6' and 'Page 5 of 6', so the sheet overprinted on PDF page 2 is form page 3. (5) All 15 rows of PDF page 3 carry the SAME date, 8/17/6, and the address column on pages 3-4 is blanked by a county redaction rectangle. (6) Most of the expenditure side is CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS OUT to other candidates and organisations. The candidate signs 'HATCH' and one expenditure reimburses 'JOSEPH HATCH' - the candidate himself.
